benchmarks.title: Your numbers and the division's
benchmarks.intro: Measured from the recording, no AI. The division is the median of {n} 1v1 games by players in the same bracket over the last 90 days.
benchmarks.notEnough: Not enough games in your division to compare yet ({n} of {min}). Your numbers are already saved.
benchmarks.noDivision: Join a league to compare your numbers with your division.
benchmarks.note: Villagers are those produced by the TC (queue simulated until Castle; after that, with several TCs, it is approximate). TC idle is estimated from gaps between queue commands; Loom and age-ups count as TC busy.

player.title: Recent numbers
player.intro: {n, plural, =1 {Your last 1v1 game with a parsed recording} other {Median of your last # 1v1 games with a parsed recording}}, next to the median of {d} games in your division over the last 90 days. No AI.
player.empty: No game of yours has a parsed recording yet. League games are read automatically; others, when you request an analysis.
